## Method, and its limits

Every entry of a Scopus BibTeX export carries its citation count. These figures
are computed from that file — no external service, no API key — and reproduce
exactly what the
[Scopus author profile](https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=34970897800)
reports: 96 documents, 2 869 citations, h-index 25.

Two indicators on that profile **cannot** be derived this way, and are therefore
absent here rather than approximated:

- **how many distinct documents cite this work** — that needs the citing
  records, not the cited ones;
- **citations received per year** — the export states how many citations a work
  has today, never when they arrived.

Self-citations are included, as they are in the Scopus figures above. Indicators
of this kind describe a body of work only coarsely, and say nothing about the
worth of any single piece of it.
